review_scope: Frozen contract, code, resulting tables, manual paired-gap calculation and interpretation

manual_calculation.method: Paired-gap harmonic-volume weighting; manual state cluster scores; prespecified full-FE CR1; t49

caveats: Weighted pooled state-year level difference; not a 2024 national gap or individual probability
Full-FE CR1 is the inherited conservative correction
Suppression allocations are not global missing-data bounds and do not cover entirely omitted products
Period estimates are descriptive; no policy effect or tested period contrast
97.840856 percent glyburide contribution is an endpoint arithmetic decomposition, not causal attribution
Older-group glipizide share was higher in 2013 through 2016; persistent positive gradient refers to glimepiride
Renal and clinical composition are unmeasured potential explanations; comparability is not established
